title: Base is great, arms fragile
text:
Base is great, arms fragile. This is a great looking ornament - and who doesn't like a shiny Dalek - but purchased this five times now (one for me, two for my adult kids who are Who fans as well). Out of those purchases, two orders were cancelled without explanation, and the other three arrived with parts broken off.

So, we love these, but there's a problem with either the packaging or the product. But he looks good on the shelf anyway.
